guard_streams.source: Premises in BDUK plans (March 2025, England and Wales)
guard_streams.write_limit: The March 2025 release uses a September 2024 planning snapshot and cannot verify current selected-parcel serviceability.

facts.detail: The premises-in-plans publication was published on 13 March 2025.
The publication applies to England and Wales.
It includes a user guide and technical note.
It provides a 175 KB sample CSV.
The publication lists ten English and Welsh regional ZIP files.
The North East ZIP is listed as 10.6 MB.
The North West ZIP is listed as 34.5 MB.
The London ZIP is listed as 38.7 MB.
The South East ZIP is listed as 44.6 MB.
The release presents BDUK's view of current connectivity, future plans and interventions, not comprehensive historic delivery.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - Leicestershire and Warwickshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Contracted and redesigned premises are procurement scope subject to planning and technical change, not proof of present-day orderability.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 6 February 2024.
It was last updated on 26 May 2026.
The original contract covered around 38,000 premises.
The original CityFibre contract value was £71 million.
The original contract was signed in January 2024.
CityFibre and BDUK redesigned the contract in May 2026.
The redesigned contract covers around 36,000 premises.
The redesigned investment is up to £76.4 million.
The redesign aims to minimise overlap with commercial rollout.
The premises list remains subject to supplier planning and technical change.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract - Kent
guard_streams.write_limit: Contract scope and redesign are procurement evidence subject to supplier planning; they do not prove current selected-parcel orderability or measured speed.

facts.detail: The Kent contract page was published on 6 February 2024.
It was last updated on 26 May 2026.
The original contract covered around 50,000 premises.
The original CityFibre contract value was £112 million.
The original contract was signed in January 2024.
CityFibre and BDUK redesigned the contract in May 2026.
The redesigned contract covers around 9,000 premises.
The redesigned investment is £26.1 million.
The redesign aims to minimise overlap with other suppliers' commercial rollout.
The premises list remains subject to detailed planning and technical change.
